hero.title: Hospital Staffing Solutions In Canada
hero.subtitle:
Hospitals staff shortage is a common challenge across Canada. This creates unnecessary pressure on existing staff.
At Goodwill Staffing, we understand how crucial it is for hospitals to keep services consistent, safe, and efficient.
Our role is to supply qualified health professionals to hospitals across Canada.

blocks.text: Why Hospitals Partner with Goodwill Staffing

blocks.html:
Staffing shortages can happen without a prior warning. A nurse calls in sick, a hospital expands services, or seasonal demand increases patient volume.

These shifts leave hospitals scrambling to maintain quality care. Traditional hiring is slow and costly, making it impossible to adapt quickly.

Goodwill Staffing provides a direct solution. We connect hospitals with pre-screened healthcare professionals who are ready to fill roles immediately.

Instead of spending weeks on job postings, interviews, and credential checks, your hospital gains access to staff who meet your requirements from day one.

We focus on three priorities:

Consistency – keeping hospital operations running smoothly.

Quality – ensuring only trained and certified staff are supplied.

Speed – delivering the right professionals exactly when you need them.

blocks.text: Our Range of Staffing Solutions for Hospitals

blocks.html:
Every hospital has unique needs, and our staffing model is built for flexibility. We provide you with staff for one shift, ongoing coverage, or specialized support. Whatever your needs are, our role is to tailor the specific solutions to them.

Nurses for Hospitals

Registered nurses and licensed practical nurses form the backbone of hospital care. We provide nurses with experience in outpatient care, chronic disease management, health assessments, immunizations, and minor procedures.

They adapt quickly to hospital workflows and support both physicians and patients with professionalism.

Personal Support Workers (PSWs)

Personal Support Workers play a vital role in patient comfort and care coordination. In hospitals, they assist with patient flow, basic assessments, and administrative support.

Our PSWs are trained, reliable, and focused on keeping your patients at ease.

Allied Health Professionals

hospitals often require specialized staff to support diagnostics, rehabilitation, and treatment.

We supply physiotherapists, respiratory therapists, occupational therapists, lab technologists, and medical imaging specialists. 

These professionals expand your hospital’s capacity to deliver comprehensive care.

Administrative and Support Staff

Smooth operations depend on more than hospital care staff. 

We can also provide administrative workers, receptionists, and medical office assistants who keep scheduling, billing, and patient records organized.

Hospitals demand a wide range of professionals across multiple departments. Staffing needs shift quickly, from emergency coverage to specialized care units. Goodwill Staffing tailors placements to meet the unique demands of each hospital department.

  • Emergency Departments – nurses and allied health staff trained to handle high-pressure, fast-paced environments.
  • Intensive Care Units (ICU) – critical care nurses and respiratory therapists experienced in advanced monitoring and life-support systems.
  • Medical and Surgical Units – RNs, LPNs, and PSWs skilled in post-operative care, medication management, and patient recovery.
  • Pediatrics and Maternity – staff who bring expertise in neonatal, maternal, and child health support.
  • Specialty Clinics Within Hospitals – lab technologists, imaging specialists, and therapists to expand diagnostic and treatment capacity.

This specialized matching ensures hospitals receive staff who are not only qualified but also prepared for the intensity and diversity of hospital care.

We know hospitals cannot compromise on patient safety. That’s why every professional we place goes through a strict vetting process:

  • Credential Verification – degrees, licenses, and certifications are confirmed.
  • Background Checks – safety and compliance standards are met.
  • Experience Review – hospital placements align with proven expertise.
  • Ongoing Training – staff keep skills updated to meet evolving healthcare standards.

This ensures when a Goodwill professional arrives at your hospital, they give their all to make an impact in your facility and beyond.

By providing staff with these specialized skills, hospitals can confidently deliver care that meets diverse patient needs.

This streamlined process saves your hospital time and ensures patient care is never interrupted.

When you work with Goodwill, you get more than a staffing agency. You get a partner invested in your hospital’s success.

items.title: We match you with qualified professionals

items.question: How fast can you provide staff for our hospital?
items.answer: Most placements are filled within 24–72 hours. We prioritize urgent needs and communicate timeline estimates from the start.

items.question: What credentials do your nurses have?
items.answer: All of our nurses are fully licensed to practice in their respective provinces. Credentials are verified upon onboarding and include background checks, vulnerable sector screening, CPR/First Aid, immunization records, and specialty certifications when applicable.

items.question: Do you provide staffing in rural or remote areas?
items.answer: Yes. We provide staffing support to rural and remote communities across Canada, including fly-in locations and underserved regions. Our mobile and travel healthcare teams are equipped to deliver care where it’s needed most.

items.question: Can we hire temporary staff permanently?
items.answer: We encourage it! Many clients use our contract-to-hire model to evaluate performance before offering a permanent position. We also offer direct permanent placement services for long-term care homes. In addition to temporary and contract coverage, we offer permanent placement services and contract-to-hire options tailored to your hospital’s hiring strategy.

items.question: What does your credentialing process include?
items.answer: All candidates are thoroughly vetted — including verification of licenses, certifications, references, and background checks. We also ensure vaccination status, vulnerable sector screenings, and regulatory compliance are up to date.

items.question: Do you have staff with specific hospital experience (ER, ICU, OR, etc.)?
items.answer: Yes. Many of our nurses and allied health professionals have direct experience in high-acuity hospital units, including emergency, operating room, intensive care, mental health, and pediatric care.

items.question: How do you ensure your staff are ready for hospital environments?
items.answer: Our team members are trained in infection control, hospital protocols, electronic charting systems, and patient safety standards. We also brief them with site-specific expectations before assignment.

items.question: Can you provide long-term or permanent staffing support?
items.answer: Absolutely. In addition to temporary and contract coverage, we offer permanent placement services and contract-to-hire options tailored to your hospital’s hiring strategy.
